blocks.text: PHILADELPHIA — LeBron James was out for the Philadelphia 76ers because of lower back pain management for Saturday’s game against the Milwaukee Bucks. James sat out the first of back-to-back games for the Sixers this weekend. They play Detroit on Sunday night. The 41-year-old James averaged 15.5 points and 9.5 rebounds over his first two games with the 76ers. Even minus James, the Sixers still had more than enough firepower to beat the Bucks, 127-116, with Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown and Tyrese Maxey combining for 82 points.
